actions.action: Remove plant and rinse roots under lukewarm water, rubbing off crust
Trim black, mushy or smelly roots with clean scissors
Check nodes and cut above black mushy ones; re-propagate healthy stems
Wash the jar with soap and water
Fully change the water every 1-2 weeks and rinse roots
Move to bright indirect light or add a desk lamp/grow light
If still stagnant, move plant to well-draining potting soil and keep moist

reason: The answer names oxygen-starved root rot from topping off plus lack of fertilizer as the main causes and gives the same rinse, trim, full-change and dilute-fertilizer fix (only missing the small-container point), with nothing harmful.
